label.en: If the tree invasion is repelled

bridges.evidence: colony.4 creates armies for a new country and sets country flag burned_forests_rampaged_country / planet flag burned_forests_rampaged_planet (events/colony_events_1.txt:206-242); on_colony_defenders_win -> colony.5 (common/on_actions/00_on_actions.txt:862), whose trigger checks those flags (colony_events_1.txt:265-267)

label.zh: 研究或烧毁（烧毁仅限非环保主义文明）
label.en: Study or burn (burn only for non-Environmentalist empires)

note.zh: 两个项目由同一选项启用，玩家完成其一；烧毁项目完成会移除迁徙加成。
note.en: Both projects are enabled by one option and the player completes one; finishing the burn project removes the migrating_forests modifier.

label.zh: 共存路线：三个事件各至多一次
label.en: Coexistence route: three events, each at most once

note.zh: 各自延迟1800+随机5400天，各由自己的标记限定，彼此独立。
note.en: Each fires 1800 days + random 5400 after colony.2, once per own flag; independent.

label.zh: 焚林路线：四个延迟事件

note.zh: colony.3 同时安排4、6、7、8（1800+随机5400天）。6与7共用标记而互斥（7还需星球没有战略资源）；4为树人入侵。
note.en: colony.3 schedules 4, 6, 7, 8 together (1800 days + random 5400). 6 and 7 share flags and exclude each other (7 also needs no strategic resource); 4 is the tree invasion.

notes.zh: 迁移事件每720+随机1680天自我重复，直到玩家完成任一项目（触发条件需要 migrating_forests 修正）。
notes.en: The migration event repeats every 720 days + random 1680 until a project is completed (its trigger needs the migrating_forests modifier).

notes.zh: 殖民地2或3岁时的随机殖民地事件（权重3/958、2/739）；非AI、非首都、非机械/荒野帝国，五种宜居星球类型；全局仅一次。
notes.en: Random colony event at colony age 2 or 3 (weights 3/958, 2/739); non-AI, non-capital colony of a non-machine/wilderness empire on five habitable classes; once per game.

scope.zh: 迁徙森林完整故事：开端、两个项目、六个后续事件、树人入侵与击退，以及自循环的迁移事件。
scope.en: Whole Migrating Forests story: opening, two projects, six follow-ups, the tree invasion and its defeat, and the self-repeating migration event.
